query:
SELECT entite, total FROM (
SELECT 'molecules' as entite, COUNT(*) as total FROM molecules
UNION ALL SELECT 'recettes', COUNT(*) FROM recettes
UNION ALL SELECT 'plants', COUNT(*) FROM plants
UNION ALL SELECT 'plant_varieties', COUNT(*) FROM plant_varieties
UNION ALL SELECT 'terroirs', COUNT(*) FROM terroirs
UNION ALL SELECT 'raw_materials', COUNT(*) FROM raw_materials
UNION ALL SELECT 'accords', COUNT(*) FROM accords
UNION ALL SELECT 'chemical_families', COUNT(*) FROM chemical_families
UNION ALL SELECT 'bibliography_entries', COUNT(*) FROM bibliography_entries
UNION ALL SELECT 'plant_molecules', COUNT(*) FROM plant_molecules
UNION ALL SELECT 'plant_terroirs', COUNT(*) FROM plant_terroirs
UNION ALL SELECT 'recette_raw_materials', COUNT(*) FROM recette_raw_materials
UNION ALL SELECT 'variety_genealogy', COUNT(*) FROM variety_genealogy
) t ORDER BY total DESC;
